horoscopes.horoscope: You feel lost and thoroughly depressed today. This will make you turn towards spirituality, says Ganesha. You will devote more time to meditation and will pray a lot. Despite the adverse circumstances, Ganesha says you will make a good deal of material headway. On the personal front, the day may remain uneventful without any major development. There will not be any significant development in this area today, feels Ganesha. If you have made promises to your beloved, you will be able to fulfil them. Working emotionally on small small things may not help you out so you may need to be practical to handle some of the things well. Ganesha suggests you to control mood swings. Your emotional barometer will be connected with your health today. If you are a professional, the chances of your finding another job are quite high, which will come with a salary hike. Alternatively, there will be possibility of you getting promoted in your present job. The day requires proper planning for the coming week. Ganesha insists that you must plan your activities for the forthcoming week. This is because day today and the following week may remain loaded with work, so you need to take good care of these things.

Religious sentiments will be ruling your thoughts today, says Ganesha. This is a great day for making a trip to a temple or a popular religious destination. You should take your parents and other family members along on this auspicious journey. Your parents are sure to pray shower their love and blessings upon you and pray for your well being. All in all, the day will turn out to be a hectic, and tiring one; but, very satisfying and enjoyable. The day will be good in the area of love relationship, feels Ganesha. You are likely to go out with your beloved in the evening. This development is going to make you feel happy. You are like to enjoy the time. Today, your day seems to be lucky and happy too. There will be strong desire to maintain health and so you might be inclined to yoga or any other exercise.You will be able to handle your routine very well. Today is the right day to invest in the stock market, tips Ganesha. So if you have not done so already, do so now. As fortune is in your favour, you will be able to multiply your money. The beginning might make you feel a crunch due to heavy workload, but later during the day you may feel relaxed and things will be under control. Second half of the day is also good for developing new ideas and thoughts, feels Ganesha.

You will be afforded full co-operation by your relatives and friends. You will also be able to provide a solution to their problems by utilising your practical thinking. You will be influenced by your emotions while choosing between multiple alternatives. You need to carefully weigh the pros and cons of any decision you make today, says Ganesha. Very good day in the area of love relationship, feels Ganesha. Your love life will be blooming at its full. You will be very happy about it. You are likely to feel great about it. The time is really good for you today. You are going to focuss all your energy, balancing between personal and professional fronts. Ganesha feels that you must use your communication skill to handle such issues and should remain witty which you already are! You shall be comfortable on the financial front today. Your future will be bright with the investment s you make today. Also for any future investments, real estate is the best option for you. You may get a feeling that your superiors are not satisfied with your work. Don’t feel burdened for that. In fact, for the entire day you should avoid meetings as your power to negotiate or discuss seems to be low and not upto the mark.

A shopping spree with your darling is likely to be the highlight of the day, even though you will be paying for almost everything. Though you have decided to be this lavish out of sheer love, your sweetheart will more than return the favour with a sweaty thank you ‘return gift’ in the evening. Your love life will suffer due to lot of work in the office, feels Ganesha. Work is heavy so you might not be able to pay due attention to your love life, resulting into an upset mood for your beloved. Your mind will be functioning actively with lot of energy and focus. Ganesha also feels you will be less emotional today and less practical. The good thing today is that your mood swings will be in control. Your day will pass smoothly. By and large, the day is not going to let you spend single penny just based on your impulse thus you will be able to be happy on the financial front, says Ganesha. Ganesha finds your mind to be active and completely focused on work today. Hence you might be in a mood for research related to work or work development. Due to heavy research, Ganesha suggests you to file or save all the information.

You will pay serious attention to your work. You will feel that you have no option but to work hard. You will not be in the mood for socialising. This is only a temporary phase, hence there is no need to worry. You will be back to your usual gregarious self in no time at all, says Ganesha. You may be in a mood to talk a lot in your love life. You ought to be careful about this point. You may be in a mood to give many suggestions to your partner. But it may not be liked by her or him. Today, Ganesha does not foresee you facing any health issue. You might get upset with someone so you may need to guard yourself against emotional imbalance. As it can spoil relation with any of the person. Since the planets are in your favour, you may expect some good financial gains today, feels Ganesha. You will be contented with your financial standing. Go ahead and make long-term plans. You are in a mood to talk a lot today, observes Ganesha. Hence you might feel like giving suggestions to everyone around you. Ganesha wants you to be careful with your words as everyone might not be able to welcome your suggestions.

Ganesha advises you to quantify your worth in the spheres of emotions and sentiments. You will prepare yourself for everything, from games to peers to family. However, at the same time you will realise your shortcomings. Ganesha foretells that from today on the artist in you will begin to come to the fore. You will see a good day on love front today. The Grace of Ganesha will keep you lovers tuned to each other’s frequency. Thus, you will have a good equation with your partner, feels Ganesha. You will have a good time today. Ganesha strongly feels that you will be very passionate about things that you wish to do in life and will be operating at good energy level today. Moreover, your mental outlook will be so good. Today, Ganesha feels that you shall be very practical, logical and analytical regarding financial matters. You will wish to organise your finances in such a way that things run smoothly in the future. You might not be able meet your deadlines today. Ganesha feels it is high time you start managing your time. It is very important to manage time as it will make you organised. At work, you will be judgemental about things.

Ganesha says that today you shall be very careful in money matters. It is nothing to do with miserliness at all. When buying things you will be careful while spending money and will stick to your budget. On the other hand when you are out with your loved ones you will not think about holding back and will spend lavishly. Ganesha says to take the balanced approach in everything in life and things will go well for you. Every day should have something special to keep the life moving in an interesting way. This will be true today as well, feels Ganesha. Your conversational skills will surely add some spice in your relationship with your beloved. You are going to enjoy it. Today, your high energy level is going to make you a handy troubleshooter in various areas. Ganesha advises you not to get disheartened for failing to solve a couple of problems. It’s a good day for you when your energy will help you. Ganesha advises you to go for full body medical check-up today and figure out what treatment you need to get back to peak fitness. You can also change your diet plan in order to remain health and fit. If you want to work with extra zest and vigour, you will have to wait till the lunch time. You may indulge actively in SMS or phone conversations with several people today. Ganesha warns you against wasting time on useless conversations.

You wish to make an image makeover in your office. You are tough and determined, and your work knows no limit when it comes to achieving your targets. You will love to brainstorm and give innovative ideas to colleagues and bosses. However, don’t give away your best of ideas to anyone, advises Ganesha. The day is going to want some requirement on your part today. Ganesha suggests you to go easy on your beloved. That is the need of the hour. You should not be too rigid or too stiif in your expectations from your partner. According to Ganesha, by virtue of your good mood and high energy, you might be able to accomplish your routine tasks very speedily.Briefly, it is a good day for you, when you will achieve tasks and that too in time. All the hard-work that you have invested lately, will now fetch in the rewards. This is a good day to discuss your financial affairs with a friend you can trust. Gains through friends are also indicated. Your colleagues will be ready to help you with your endeavours today. You may get lucky, and your superiors may also help you. Today you will have a wonderful time in professional and personal life. All this is going to delight you, feels Ganesha.

Your far-sightedness and brilliance will not only impress your peers, but also help you to rope in big clients and huge projects. Cheers to that! Thanks to your systematic and disciplined approach, you are entitled to be the ‘most desirable’ employee of the company. Business may look forward to huge profits, predicts Ganesha. You need extra goodness in your behaviour today in order to manage your love life so that your partner stays happy. Ganesha advises you to try and be as nice as possible to your beloved or life partner in order to avoid heartburns today. Ganesha says that your pending list will be full and you might need remain a bit pragmatic to meet the work deadline. Being emotional may not help you in completing your work so be pragmatic for the work. Today you are likely to be more action oriented in your work, foresees Ganesha. This will definitely help on the financial front. Today’s hard work will fetch rich rewards in the future. Even if the day beings very nicely, in second half of the day you will be bothered due to some technical issues related to work. Your mindset will require a change and you will need to learn to forget and forgive.

Whatever field you are in, your career matters will top your priority list. You will put your personal life on the back burner for a while. This change of places will surely bring you great rewards as your performance will drastically improve and everyone will appreciate your efforts. Credit goes to your family members and well-wishers for believing in you in the toughest of times and supporting you along the way, says Ganesha. On the romantic front, you will be able to spend good time with your partner. This good time spent will make you happy. Ganesha foresees the day as a favourable day for you, more so as you maintain peace during the day. Today, you might rely only on your luck and perhaps, pay less attention on work in the office. You might also remain busy because of the meetings, says Ganesha. Your energy level will be okay Today you shall keep a tight fist and not spend unnecessarily. You will also have an eye out for spotting other means of earning an extra buck. You will try to tap your contacts to get some freelance projects. Ganesha finds your attention bifurcated in two parts – professional and domestic. Ganesha suggests you to be practical to get rid of any confusion that arises. You should try to avoid this conflict between the two areas. You should try to be balanced.

It’s a day you may want to spend with yourself. But it may still not bring the desired peace and tranquility. An unpleasant situation may force you to deal with reality, says Ganesha. You now realise how much strength you derive from your devotion to God. Ganesha does not foresee much exciting things in your love life today. In fact, there is no spice in love life today, unless you go ahead and add some. So, you will have to make the efforts to add the spice and excitement. You will be dynamic in your manner today. While you are likely to fulfill several social and official obligations today, you should be careful of colleagues who are jealous of your efficiency. Overall, it’s a good day for you, says Ganesha. The day is good for noting down various ideas to make money but the day is not good for implementation of such ideas, as per Ganesha’s view. In short, today you should not have high hopes for money matters. A perfect day to get rid of those pending files and to finish off social engagements. At office, interaction with colleagues is higher in order to solve pending issues. Nevertheless, Ganesha advises you against people who might be jealous of you.

You will find favourable conditions at work as you co-ordinate with your colleagues and seniors to tackle tough problems. You will be able to get the desirable results for all the effort you put in, in the office, says Ganesha. Those engaging in business will be able to make some strong and useful contacts today which will be handy in the future. Ganesha suggests that you be outgoing today and continue to do so to maintain your profits. You will see lot of happiness on the love front, feels Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that for you ‘happy times’ will rule today. In addition to this, love life will smoother than ever. So, it’s going to be good and enjoyable day for you Today, in the office or at the home, you will be quite receptive to others’ views. As you are an emotional person, you take things to your heart in small-small matters. But today, you should take criticism constructively. Today you will be spending a fortune on your beloved and family members. You are anyway prone to extravagance, and today you will be able to spend good money on people you hold in esteem. Emotions might seem very important today. Since you are feeling emotionally weak, do not feel hurt if someone tries to point out your mistakes, advises Ganesha. Try to avoid any pressure or tension due to this. You should be strong and calm.
